# Trio

> Trio is a complete financial platform for companies in Brazil, authorized by the Central Bank of Brazil (No. 619, ISPB 49931906). Its V2 REST API lets you onboard customers, open bank accounts, receive money through Pix and boleto, pay Pix transfers, boletos, utility bills and taxes, issue corporate cards, and track every money movement through documents and webhooks. The Trio Checkout SDK embeds Pix pay-in and pay-out flows in your web or mobile app.

Key facts an agent needs before reading further:

- This index covers the V2 API. Every V2 path starts with `/v2`. The V1 API is legacy and its pages are served under the version switcher at https://docs.trio.com.br/v1.
- Base URLs: production `https://api.trio.com.br`, sandbox `https://api.sandbox.trio.com.br`. Sandbox is a full, isolated copy of the API for testing.
- Authentication is HTTP Basic: `client_id` as username and `client_secret` as password. Credentials are created in the Trio App under API Keys and are specific to each environment.
- Requests carry a `Trio-Version` header; a missing or outdated value is refused with `400 INVALID_TRIO_VERSION`. To act on another organization you have access to, send the `Trio-Target-Org-Id` header with the same credentials.
- There are no virtual accounts in V2. Every receivable and payment names the `bank_account_id` of the bank account that receives or pays.
- Monetary amounts are sent as integers in cents in BRL (`100000` means R$ 1.000,00) and returned as `{ "amount", "currency" }` objects.
- Timestamps are UTC in ISO 8601 with microseconds, for example `2026-10-07T20:16:02.471297Z`; calendar dates such as due dates are `YYYY-MM-DD`.
- List endpoints use cursor pagination: responses carry `metadata.after`, `metadata.before` and `metadata.has_more`; pass one cursor back as a query parameter. Document listings require `from_datetime` and `to_datetime`.
- Every money movement is a document under `/v2/documents`: in (cash-in), out (cash-out) or transfer, each with its refunds. Documents are the source of truth for reconciliation.
- Send a unique `external_id` on cash-in and cash-out requests. It is used for reconciliation and webhook matching.
- Errors use HTTP status codes and a JSON body with `error.error_code`, `error.error_message` and, for schema errors, `error.errors[]`. Validation and business-rule failures return `422`. Updates and cancellations return `204 No Content`.
- Rate limits: 60 requests per second in production and 5 in sandbox, per account and per endpoint. A `429` response means back off and retry.
- Every response carries an `X-Request-Id` header. Quote it when contacting support.
- Most operations are asynchronous. Webhooks deliver the final state as HTTP POST with a JSON body; a webhook chooses the payload version with `api_version` (`v100` or `v200`).
- Trio MCP, a hosted Model Context Protocol server at `https://mcp.trio.com.br/mcp`, lets AI clients such as Claude and ChatGPT read the organization's balances, statements, payments, transfers and cards through OAuth. All its tools are read-only.
- Pages are available as Markdown by appending `.md` to any documentation URL. The full documentation in one file is at https://docs.trio.com.br/llms-full.txt.

## Getting started

- [Welcome](https://docs.trio.com.br/index.md): Trio API documentation: what Trio does, what changed in V2 and where to start
- [Plan your integration](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/getting_started/plan-your-integration.md): What a Trio integration involves, how long it usually takes and where to start on the API
- [Sandbox account](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/guides/sandbox_account.md): Create a free sandbox account to test the Trio API and webhooks without financial risk
- [First API credential](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/guides/creating-your-first-api-credential.md): Create a Client ID and Secret Key in the Trio App to authenticate your API requests
- [First webhook](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/guides/creating-your-first-webhook.md): Register a webhook in the Trio App and start receiving event notifications
- [Support](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/getting_started/support.md): Support channels, availability, the user manual and what to include when reporting an issue

## API conventions

- [Environments](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/developers/environments.md): Production and sandbox base URLs for the API
- [Authentication](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/developers/authentication.md): How to authenticate V2 requests, act on another organization and which headers every request carries
- [Concepts](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/developers/concepts.md): Core objects of the API: company, entity, group, bank account, counterparty and documents
- [Error handling](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/developers/error-table.md): HTTP status codes, the error body and the error codes returned by the API
- [Pagination](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/developers/pagination.md): How V2 list endpoints paginate with before and after cursors, limit and has_more
- [Date and time](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/developers/date-and-time.md): Date and time formats used by the API: UTC timestamps and plain dates
- [Rate limits](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/developers/rate-limit.md): Rate limits per environment and how to back off when the API answers 429
- [Request identification](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/developers/request-identification.md): Request identifiers and how to use them with support

## Webhooks

- [Webhooks](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/webhooks/introduction.md): Register a webhook so Trio notifies your system when a transaction or an onboarding changes state, and learn how Trio delivers and retries each notification
- [Webhook authentication](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/webhooks/authentication.md): Choose how Trio authenticates to your notification URL and verify that each notification was sent by Trio and not altered in transit
- [Content and structure](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/webhooks/content-and-structure.md): Read the envelope every V2 notification shares and find the event-specific data inside it
- [Events](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/webhooks/events/overview.md): Every event category Trio can send to a V2 webhook, with the types of each category and an example payload

## Guides

- [Customer onboarding](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/guides/onboarding-guide.md): Open an organization for a customer through the onboarding API, follow its compliance analysis through webhooks and operate on the customer's behalf once it is approved
- [Receivables](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/guides/receivables/overview.md): How to receive money on Trio: Pix QR codes, boletos, Pix Automático, fees, split payments and sandbox simulations
- [Cash in](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/guides/receivables/cash-in.md): Create your first dynamic QR code with the API and read the response
- [QR code types](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/guides/pix/qr-codes.md): Choose between static, dynamic and dynamic-with-due-date Pix QR codes, and generate a dynamic QR code
- [Pix Automático](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/guides/receivables/using-pix-automatic.md): Create recurrences, manage collections and attempts, and follow each step through webhooks with the API
- [Create a boleto](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/guides/boleto/create-boleto.md): Build the request body of POST /v2/in/boletos, from the charge and payer to discounts, fines, interest and splits, and read the boleto that comes back
- [Boleto types](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/guides/boleto/boleto-types.md): Choose the invoice_type and wallet_type values that classify a boleto when you create it
- [Boleto best practices](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/guides/boleto/best-practices.md): Understand how a boleto behaves after creation, from the embedded Pix QR code and the document lifecycle to webhooks, due dates, refunds and rate limits
- [Fees](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/guides/receivables/fees.md): Charge a fee on the payment of a receivable and keep the margin above your Trio cost
- [Split payments](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/guides/receivables/split-payments.md): Distribute the amount of a receivable among split recipients on QR codes and boletos
- [Document lifecycle](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/guides/pix/document-lifecycle.md): Statuses and stages an in document goes through in the Trio API
- [Simulate a successful deposit](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/guides/receivables/simulating-deposit-success.md): Settle a sandbox deposit end to end by paying your own QR code from a second bank account
- [Simulate deposit failures](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/guides/receivables/simulating-deposit-failures.md): Use bank account parameters to reproduce rejected and refunded deposits in the sandbox
- [Payments](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/guides/payments/overview.md): Cash-out guides for V2: paying Pix keys, BR codes, bank accounts, boletos, utility bills, taxes and DARFs from your bank accounts
- [Cash out](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/guides/payments/cash-out.md): Pay a Pix key, a BR code or a bank account from one of your bank accounts, asynchronously or after checking the receiver
- [Pix key formats](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/guides/pix/using-pix-key.md): Check which Pix key types the API accepts and the regular expression that validates each one
- [Integration best practices](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/operations/best-practices.md): How cash-in and cash-out identifiers, statuses, timeouts and webhooks behave on the API, and how to handle them so your reconciliation never breaks
- [Closed-loop reconciliation](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/operations/closed-loop.md): The compliance rules Trio applies to deposits and payouts on a bank account, so every transaction is either received or refused with an event you can act on

## Trio SDK (Trio Checkout)

- [Trio SDK](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/trio-sdk/introduction.md): What Trio Checkout is, which flows it offers and where to start embedding it in your website or app
- [Using the SDK](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/trio-sdk/using-the-sdk.md): Embed Trio Checkout in your website, create a session in your back end and open the checkout for your users
- [Local example](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/trio-sdk/local-example.md): Run a complete Trio Checkout example on your machine, with a Node.js back end that creates the session and a static front end that opens the checkout
- [PayIn flow](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/trio-sdk/flows/payin.md): Create a payin checkout session so your users can cash in money through Trio Checkout with almost zero friction
- [PayOut flow](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/trio-sdk/flows/payout.md): Create a payout checkout session so your users can withdraw money to a Pix key of their own through Trio Checkout

## Trio MCP

- [What is Trio MCP?](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/mcp/what-is-trio-mcp.md): Connect Claude, ChatGPT and other AI clients to your Trio account through the Model Context Protocol, read-only
- [Connecting Trio MCP](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/mcp/connecting.md): Add https://mcp.trio.com.br/mcp to Claude, Claude Code, ChatGPT, Cursor or any MCP client, sign in with OAuth, and keep the connection secure
- [Supported tools](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/mcp/tools.md): Every tool the Trio MCP server exposes today, what each one returns, the parameters it needs and a prompt that triggers it

## API reference: onboarding, entities, counterparties and bank accounts

- [Onboard entity](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/onboarding/create.md): Onboards an entity
- [Upload onboarding document](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/onboarding/create-document.md): Uploads a PDF document the onboarding asked for, of the entity or of one of its representatives
- [List entities](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/entities/list.md): List entities by org ID
- [Get entity by ID](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/entities/get.md): Shows an entity
- [List Counterparties](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/counterparties/list-counterparties.md): List counterparties
- [Get Counterparty](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/counterparties/get-counterparty.md): Show a counterparty
- [Find or Create Counterparty](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/counterparties/create-counterparty.md): Find or create a counterparty
- [List Counterparty Bank Accounts](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/counterparties/bank-accounts/list-counterparty-bank-accounts.md): Lists counterparty bank accounts by counterparty ID
- [Get Counterparty Bank Account](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/counterparties/bank-accounts/get-counterparty-bank-account.md): Show a counterparty bank account
- [Create Counterparty Bank Account](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/counterparties/bank-accounts/create-counterparty-bank-account.md): Creates a counterparty bank account
- [Create Counterparty Recipient](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/counterparties/recipients/create-counterparty-recipient.md): Creates a counterparty recipient
- [Show Counterparty Recipient](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/counterparties/recipients/get-counterparty-recipient.md): Show a counterparty recipient
- [List Counterparty Recipients](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/counterparties/recipients/list-counterparty-recipients.md): Lists the recipients of a counterparty
- [List Bank Accounts](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/bank-accounts/list-bank-accounts.md): List all available bank accounts
- [Get Bank Account](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/bank-accounts/get-bank-account.md): Shows a bank account
- [Create Bank Account](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/bank-accounts/create-bank-account.md): Creates a bank account
- [Update Bank Account Parameters](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/bank-accounts/update-bank-account.md): Update bank account parameters
- [List Bank Account Transactions](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/bank-accounts/transactions/list-bank-account-transactions.md): List transactions
- [Get Bank Account Balances](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/bank-accounts/balances/get-bank-account-balances.md): Gets the available balance of a bank account at a date and time (now by default), with its current balances and limits
- [Get Bank Account Metrics](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/bank-accounts/metrics/get-bank-account-metrics.md): Get settled and failed totals for in, out and transfer documents
- [List institutions](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/institutions/list.md): List institutions - Banking

## API reference: receivables (cash-in)

- [Create boleto](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/receivables/boletos/post.md): Creates a new boleto
- [List boletos](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/receivables/boletos/list.md): List all available boletos
- [Get boleto](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/receivables/boletos/get.md): Gets a specific boleto
- [Update boleto due date](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/receivables/boletos/update.md): Changes the due date of a boleto. To change its amount, recreate it
- [Cancel boleto](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/receivables/boletos/cancel.md): Cancel a boleto
- [Recreate boleto](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/receivables/boletos/recreate.md): Cancels a boleto and creates a new one with the same fields, the new amount and the new due date (or the current one)
- [Add protest](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/receivables/boletos/add-protest.md): Add protest to a boleto
- [Remove protest](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/receivables/boletos/remove-protest.md): Remove protest from a boleto
- [Create static QR code](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/receivables/pix/qrcode-static/post.md): Create a new static QRCode
- [Get static QR code](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/receivables/pix/qrcode-static/get.md): Get a specific static QRCode
- [Get static QR code image](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/receivables/pix/qrcode-static/get-image.md): Gets a static QRCode image
- [Get static QR code hash](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/receivables/pix/qrcode-static/get-hash.md): Gets a static QRCode hash
- [Create dynamic QR code](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/receivables/pix/qrcode-dynamic/post.md): Creates a new dynamic pix QRCode
- [Get dynamic QR code](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/receivables/pix/qrcode-dynamic/get.md): Gets a specific dynamic QRCode
- [Update dynamic QR code](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/receivables/pix/qrcode-dynamic/update.md): Updates a dynamic pix QRCode
- [Get dynamic QR code image](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/receivables/pix/qrcode-dynamic/get-image.md): Gets a dynamic pix QRCode image
- [Get dynamic QR code hash](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/receivables/pix/qrcode-dynamic/get-hash.md): Gets a dynamic hash
- [Create dynamic QR code with due date](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/receivables/pix/qrcode-with-due/post.md): Creates a new dynamic pix QRCode with due date, allowing fine, interest, rebate and discount rules
- [Get dynamic QR code with due date](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/receivables/pix/qrcode-with-due/get.md): Gets a specific dynamic QRCode with due date
- [Get dynamic QR code with due date image](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/receivables/pix/qrcode-with-due/get-image.md): Gets the image of a dynamic pix QRCode with due date
- [Get dynamic QR code with due date hash](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/receivables/pix/qrcode-with-due/get-hash.md): Gets the hash of a dynamic QRCode with due date
- [Refund Pix](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/receivables/pix/refunds/post.md): Refund an in document
- [List Recurrences](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/receivables/recurrences/list-recurrences.md): List recurrences with parameters
- [Generate a Recurrence](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/receivables/recurrences/generate-recurrence.md): Generate a recurrence
- [Get Recurrence](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/receivables/recurrences/get-recurrence.md): Get recurrence with stages
- [Cancel Recurrence](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/receivables/recurrences/cancel-recurrence.md): Cancel recurrence by ID
- [List Recurrence Collections](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/receivables/recurrences/list-recurrence-collections.md): List recurrence collections with parameters
- [Get Collection](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/receivables/recurrences/get-collection.md): Get recurrence collection
- [Update Collection](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/receivables/recurrences/update-collection.md): Update collection Amount by ID
- [Cancel Collection](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/receivables/recurrences/cancel-collection.md): Cancel collection by ID
- [Schedule Collection](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/receivables/recurrences/schedule-collection.md): Schedule collection
- [Create Next Collection](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/receivables/recurrences/create-next-collection.md): Create next collection

## API reference: payments (cash-out)

- [Check Pix Key](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/payments/pix/transfer-pix/check-key.md): Checks a key
- [Get Pix Key Check](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/payments/pix/transfer-pix/get-key-check.md): Gets a specific check key
- [Generate a Pix Payment](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/payments/pix/transfer-pix/generate-pix-payment.md): Generates a pix payment
- [Generate a Pix Payment (async)](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/payments/pix/transfer-pix/generate-pix-payment-async.md): Generates an async pix payment
- [Check Pix BR Code](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/payments/pix/brcode/check-brcode.md): Checks a brcode hash
- [Get Pix BR Code Check](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/payments/pix/brcode/get-brcode-check.md): Gets a specific check brcode hash
- [Generate a Pix Payment (BR Code)](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/payments/pix/brcode/generate-pix-payment-brcode.md): Generates a pix payment
- [Check boleto](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/payments/boleto/check-boleto.md): Check a boleto barcode or line code
- [Pay boleto](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/payments/boleto/pay-boleto.md): Generate a pay boleto
- [Pay boleto (async)](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/payments/boleto/pay-boleto-async.md): Generate an async pay boleto
- [Check Utility](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/payments/utility/check-utility.md): Check a utility barcode or line code
- [Pay Utility](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/payments/utility/pay-utility.md): Generate a pay utility
- [Pay Utility (async)](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/payments/utility/pay-utility-async.md): Generate an async pay utility
- [Check Tax](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/payments/tax/check-tax.md): Check a tax barcode or line code
- [Pay Tax](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/payments/tax/pay-tax.md): Generate a pay tax
- [Pay Tax (async)](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/payments/tax/pay-tax-async.md): Generate an async pay tax
- [Check DARF](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/payments/darf/check-darf.md): Check a DARF
- [Pay DARF](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/payments/darf/pay-darf.md): Generate a pay DARF
- [Pay DARF (async)](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/payments/darf/pay-darf-async.md): Generate an async pay DARF
- [Transfer](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/transfers/transfer.md): Requests a transfer between two bank accounts. trio-spi creates the transfer document asynchronously, so the request answers 200 with the ID it will have

## API reference: documents and reconciliation

- [List Receivables](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/documents/receivables/list-receivables.md): List all in documents
- [Get Receivable](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/documents/receivables/get-receivable.md): Get an in document
- [Search Receivables](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/documents/receivables/search-receivables.md): Search in document
- [List Receivable Refunds](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/documents/receivables-refunds/list-receivable-refunds.md): List all in document refunds
- [Get Receivable Refund](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/documents/receivables-refunds/get-receivable-refund.md): Get an in document refund
- [Search Receivable Refunds](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/documents/receivables-refunds/search-receivable-refunds.md): Search in document refund by IDs
- [List Payments](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/documents/payments/list-payments.md): List all out documents
- [Get Payment](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/documents/payments/get-payment.md): Get an out document
- [Search Payments](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/documents/payments/search-payments.md): Search out document by IDs
- [List Payment Refunds](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/documents/payments-refunds/list-payment-refunds.md): List out document refunds
- [Get Payment Refund](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/documents/payments-refunds/get-payment-refund.md): Get an out document refund
- [Search Payment Refunds](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/documents/payments-refunds/search-payment-refunds.md): Search out document refund by IDs
- [List Transfers](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/documents/transfers/list-transfers.md): List transfer documents
- [Get Transfer](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/documents/transfers/get-transfer.md): Gets a transfer document

## API reference: cards

- [Create Card](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/cards/create-card.md): Create a new card
- [List Cards](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/cards/list-cards.md): List cards, without their balance. Read a card for its balance
- [Get Card](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/cards/get-card.md): Get an existing card
- [Update Card](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/cards/update-card.md): Update card display name
- [Block Card](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/cards/block-card.md): Block an existing card
- [Unblock Card](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/cards/unblock-card.md): Unblock an existing card
- [Cancel Card](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/cards/cancel-card.md): Cancel an existing card
- [Get Card Details](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/cards/get-card-details.md): Card sensitive information: holder name, card number, expiration date and cvv
- [Top Up Card Balance](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/cards/top-up-card-balance.md): Top Up card balance
- [Generate Card Top Up QR Code](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/cards/generate-card-top-up-qrcode.md): Generate QR Code for Card Top Up card balance
- [Transfer Card Balance](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/cards/transfer-card-balance.md): Transfer card balance to another card
- [List Card Invoices](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/cards/list-card-invoices.md): List Card Invoices
- [Get Card Current Invoice](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/cards/get-card-current-invoice.md): Get Card current Invoice
- [List Card Invoice Lines](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/cards/list-card-invoice-lines.md): List lines for a specific Card Invoice
- [Generate Card Invoice Statement CSV URL](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/cards/generate-card-invoice-statement-csv-url.md): Generate Card Invoice Statement CSV URL for an invoice
- [List Card Purchase Documents](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/cards/list-card-purchase-documents.md): List Card purchase documents
- [Show Card Purchase Document by ID](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/cards/show-card-purchase-document-by-id.md): Show Card purchase document by id
- [Show Card Purchase Document by End to End ID](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/cards/show-card-purchase-document-by-end-to-end-id.md): Show card purchase document by end to end id

## API reference: pledged advance requests

- [List Advance Requests](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/pledged/list-advance-requests.md): List pledged advance requests of an entity
- [Create Advance Request](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/pledged/create-advance-request.md): Create a pledged advance request, uploading its contract file
- [Get Advance Request](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/pledged/get-advance-request.md): Get a pledged advance request
- [Cancel Advance Request](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/pledged/cancel-advance-request.md): Cancel a pledged advance request

## API reference: webhooks management

- [List Webhooks](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/developers/webhooks/list-webhooks.md): Lists every webhook of the org, in a single page: the list is not paginated
- [Get Webhook](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/developers/webhooks/get-webhook.md): Get org webhook
- [Create Webhook](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/developers/webhooks/create-webhook.md): Create org webhook
- [Delete Webhook](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/developers/webhooks/delete-webhook.md): Delete org webhook
- [Replace Webhook](https://docs.trio.com.br/v2/api-reference/banking-api/developers/webhooks/replace-webhook.md): Replaces the webhook with the one sent: send every field, as an omitted field is cleared
